file_id: Kolkata Municipal Corporation And Anr vs Debraj Dhur & Ors on 17 October, 2023

sentences.text:
Kolkata Municipal Corporation And Anr vs Debraj Dhur & Ors on
17 October, 2023
Author: Arijit Banerjee

Bench: Arijit Banerjee
 Od-2
 Apo/555/2017
 with
 Wpo/49/2017
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Original Side
 Kolkata Municipal Corporation And Anr.
 -Vs-
 Debraj Dhur & Ors.
Before:
The Hon'ble Justice Arijit Banerjee
And The Hon'ble Justice Apurba Sinha Ray Date : October 17, 2023.
Appearance:

Mr. Asok Kr. Banerjee, Sr. Adv.
Mr. Alak Kr. Ghosh, Adv.
...for Kmc.

The Court: From the records we find that a coordinate Bench had passed an order on December 16,2019, calling upon the relevant Land Acquisition Collector to file a report which will contain the extent of land covered by the Acquisition Notice, the extent of land that the writ petitioner has actually lost and the quantum of compensation assessed by the Collector.

Mr. Banerjee, learned senior counsel, appearing for the Corporation along with Mr.
Ghosh, learned senior counsel, says that there are other issues on which instruction needs to be obtained.
Firstly, possibly Kolkata Municipal Corporation challenged the order dated December 16, 2019, by way of a Special Leave Petition.
The fate of such SLP has to be ascertained.

Secondly, there also appears to be an issue pertaining to Kolkata Municipal Corporation And Anr vs Debraj Dhur & Ors on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137272730/
1 the Urban Land Ceiling Act, which may be relevant to the present case.

entities.text: Kolkata Municipal Corporation And Anr vs Debraj Dhur & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As suggested, let this matter stand adjourned and be listed again on December 5,
2023.
